title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Arrears Read Over the Agreement's Billing Cycle
content:
## Accounts receivable table

The arrears a charge for instalments left unpaid acts on, on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record, follow the cycle the agreement is billed on. The instalment count of the agreement's tier decides which window the arrears are read over.

| Instalments a year the agreement is billed in | The arrears the charge acts on |
|---|---|
| 12 | the instalments that fell due in the last 2 months less the payments received in those 2 months |
| 4 | the instalments that fell due in the last 4 months less the payments received in those 4 months |
| fewer than 4 | the instalments invoiced on the agreement less every payment received on it |

### Notes to the table

- Where the agreement is billed in 12 instalments a year, the window is the last 2 months: an instalment is counted when its due day falls inside those 2 months, and a payment is counted when the day it was received falls inside them.
- Where the agreement is billed in 4 instalments a year, the window widens to the last 4 months, read on the same two days — the due day of the instalment and the day the payment was received.
- Where the agreement is billed in fewer than 4 instalments a year, no window is applied: every instalment invoiced on the agreement and every payment received on it are taken.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- An agreement billed in 12 instalments a year, with 900.00 USD of instalments falling due in the last 2 months and 300.00 USD received in those same 2 months: the arrears the charge acts on are 600.00 USD, whatever older instalments stand further back.
- An agreement billed in 4 instalments a year, with 2 400.00 USD falling due in the last 4 months and 1 000.00 USD received in them: the arrears the charge acts on are 1 400.00 USD.
- An agreement billed annually in 1 instalment: every instalment invoiced and every payment received on the agreement are taken, with no window at all.
